newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish man shot in head in suspected ETA attack.
newsitem.headline: Spanish man shot in head in suspected ETA attack.

text.p: A man was shot in the head and seriously injured in northern Spain on Tuesday in an apparent attack by ETA Basque separatist rebels, police said.

Basque police said three attackers approached Javier Perez, 40, while he was walking his dog in the Basque town of Bilbao and shot him in the head. He was transferred to a local hospital where he is undergoing surgery, officials said.
The car the attackers used to flee the scene later exploded but no one was injured, police said.
Perez, who worked for an insurance company, was the cousin of a Bilbao Socialist town councillor.
Local officials described him as an active Socialist who had organised security for a number of Socialist events in recent months.
ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) has killed some 800 people in its 29-year struggle for independence.
